description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the FreeType Cache Manager, including cache management functions, constants, and data types related to cache nodes, caches, and cache management.

classes.name: FTC_ManagerRec
classes.description: Structure representing the cache manager, including library, memory, cache nodes, cache list, and face/size lists.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Compress
methods.description: Checks the cache state and flushes old cache nodes if necessary.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_FlushN
methods.description: Attempts to flush a specified number of old cache nodes.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_RegisterCache
methods.description: Registers a new cache with the cache manager.
